lines.en: I drift on wide wings
My wing membrane is nearly see-through
I pass through the wall
I glide along the ceiling

lines.zh: 我没有重量，风一推就走
lines.en: I have no weight, a breeze moves me
I swoop down from the cave roof
I circle the pillar twice
My body is half transparent
I fly without a sound

lines.zh: 我从一扇窗飘到另一扇
lines.en: I drift from window to window
A ghost bat passes through the leaves.
I head for the cold
I passed through the wooden door

lines.zh: 半空停了一下，看不见我。
lines.en: I paused mid-air. You can't see me.
My wings hardly beat at all
I have no body, only an outline.
I hang from the ceiling
I wrap my wings around me
This room is old, that is good

lines.zh: 我挂在梁上，肚子里是空的。
lines.en: I hang from the beam with nothing inside me.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，把我吹得发颤。
lines.en: The wind passes through me and makes me shiver.
Nobody sees me

lines.zh: 我展开一只翅膀，试了试风。
lines.en: I spread one wing and test the air.
The air in this room is cold
I cling to the beam
I listen to the wind on the roof
I stay still like a piece of cloth
This is where I fly

lines.zh: 我没有生成表，也没有掉落。
lines.en: No spawn table, no loot.
You only get afraid when I look at you

lines.zh: 我穿过你的时候，你会冷
lines.en: When I pass through you, you will feel cold
I have no voice and no teeth
You hold a lamp, I dislike it
I come to your room often

lines.zh: 我不是活的东西，也不是死的
lines.en: I am neither living nor dead

lines.zh: 灯照过来，我的影子淡得看不见。
lines.en: The lamp comes, and my shadow is too faint to see.

lines.zh: 手伸过来，只会抓一把凉气。
lines.en: Reach out and you'll grab only cold air.
I stop before your eyes
I scatter and slowly close
A hole opened in my membrane
I retreat toward the wall

lines.zh: 这一下打在我身上，很实
lines.en: That landed solidly on me
I look more transparent now
I cannot cry out
I cling to the ceiling and stay still

lines.zh: 这点伤碰不到我的骨头
lines.en: This wound cannot reach my bones
I slowly float up again

lines.zh: 翼膜被划开，我漏了一点雾。
lines.en: My wing membrane is slit and a little mist leaks out.

lines.zh: 我连舌头都没有，别举了。
lines.en: I don't even have a tongue; stop holding it up.

lines.zh: 那点东西对我不算什么
lines.en: That means nothing to me
Set it down, I will look
I have no stomach
The light in your hand draws me more
I circle it once

lines.zh: 那东西从我的翼上滑下去了
lines.en: It slid right off my wing

lines.zh: 你手里的热气，比食物好闻。
lines.en: The warmth in your hand smells better than food.

lines.zh: 我连掉落的影子都没有。
lines.en: I don't even leave a drop.

lines.zh: 我只想要一个安静的房间
lines.en: I only want a quiet room
You passed through me

lines.zh: 我也从你身上穿过去了
lines.en: And I passed through you
You will feel a moment of cold
Neither of us touched anything
My body leaves no mark

lines.zh: 你回头找，我已经在后面
lines.en: Look back and I am behind you
I am not solid, I make no sound
That stirred the curtain

lines.zh: 我从你后颈穿过去，很凉。
lines.en: I pass through the back of your neck, cold.

lines.zh: 我们从彼此之间过去了
lines.en: We passed through each other
Ghost bats rarely meet a companion
When kin meet, our membranes overlap
Two drifting together make the room colder
We have no nest, only empty houses
It flies very lightly

lines.zh: 我们一起穿过同一面墙
lines.en: We pass through the same wall
Neither calls the other
We stay one night in an old house
At daylight we go our own ways

lines.zh: 也许下个空屋还能遇上
lines.en: Perhaps we meet in the next empty house
A ghost bat's claws are insubstantial.
It passed through me
I carry it on my membrane
If it dropped, leave it
I cannot pick this up

lines.zh: 我用翼尖拨了拨，它没动。
lines.en: I nudge it with a wing tip, and it doesn't move.
I nudged it off the table
I do not need it
It landed loudly
This is not worth stopping for
There is someone in this room
I drift toward that warmth
I stop at the edge of your sight

lines.zh: 你的灯照不到房梁这一角。
lines.en: Your lamp doesn't reach this corner of the beam.
I turn from the ceiling
The air here is wrong

lines.zh: 我从房梁垂下来，一寸一寸。
lines.en: I lower myself from the beam, inch by inch.
This wall is no obstacle to me
I know this room
I am right above you
I drift above you

lines.zh: 你看不见我，也听得见风声
lines.en: You cannot see me, but you hear the wind
One pass through a door and I am there

lines.zh: 我飞过去一点声音都没有
lines.en: I fly over without a sound
The fire you lit is dimming
I slip along the corner

lines.zh: 我一点点靠近你的肩膀
lines.en: I come nearer to your shoulder
The air here grows colder
Turn around and I am gone
I drift between you and the lamp
I pass through your body
Only a chill where it touched
My wing membrane brushes your face
My hand sinks into your chest
Your heart skipped once
That made you shudder
I have no claws, only cold

lines.zh: 我在你耳边呼气，没有声。
lines.en: I breathe by your ear without a sound.
Your whole arm has gone numb
I draw back and float at the door
I come out of the wall
This empty house will do
I rest on the beam first
The room was empty, now it has me

lines.zh: 我的翼膜一点点显出来
lines.en: My membrane fades into view
There is a place for me on the ceiling
I drift in through the window
The air here is cold

lines.zh: 我发出一点很轻的声音
lines.en: I make a very faint sound
I hang down slowly
The firelight made me visible

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，散成一片雾
lines.en: I fall from above and scatter into mist
The water pressed me down
The blast's light went right through me
Something flying went straight through me
That force caught hold of me
I do not starve, I only fade

lines.zh: 雷光里，我薄得只剩一层灰。
lines.en: In the lightning, I'm thin as a layer of ash.
There are not even walls in the void
